text:
sara_pm: Heads-up: we intend to deprecate the Partner SDK synchronous callback envelope (callbacks in-body) in favor of a standardized async webhook envelope (event.records array + hmac v2) across marketplace connectors and SI integrations. Planning to announce next week.

josh_partnerships: Why the switch? any major compatibility risks for partners?

sara_pm: Main drivers: resilient retries across unreliable networks, uniform replay protection, and simpler backpressure handling for on-prem connectors. It's a breaking change for partners that post callbacks in the old shape.

lee_sdk: We should keep a compatibility mode on the server to accept old envelopes for a migration window, but we shouldn't encourage long-term use. I can add a flag in SDKs to auto-migrate payload and sign with new HMAC v2 header.

nina_security: HMAC v2 includes timestamp + nonce and uses a rotating key mechanism. We'll publish KMS rotation guidance. For hardware/on-prem partners, rotating keys may require firmware updates. Need to flag that.

ian_hw: Yup — for some embedded partners, updating firmware for key rotation is non-trivial. We'll need a 120-day hardware window and vendor sign-off. I'll pull the embed partner list and map firmware owners.

partner-bot: Canary test job scheduled: partners/webhook-envelope-canary (2026-05-12T08:00Z). Results will post to #partners-canary.

sara_pm: Proposed timeline: announce -> 30 day opt-in canary -> 60 day marketplace cutoff (auto-upgrade safe) -> 120 day enterprise/hardware cutoff. Compatibility server shim available for two minor releases after cutoff only. Thoughts?

josh_partnerships: Suggest two partner tracks: marketplace connectors (auto-push updates, short window) vs manual SI/hardware (longer window + migration sprints). Add a migration checklist for each.

lee_sdk: Tech plan from SDK side:
- v2 envelope shape: {"event": "name", "records": [{"id":"...","payload":{...}}], "meta":{}}
- new auth header: X-RW-HMAC-V2: base64(nonce + hmac)
- SDK will detect old shape and call /compat/migrate endpoint to receive a signed migration token.
- add e2e tests: node/python/go client -> canary -> partner CI.

nina_security: Also require a verification library for partners that validates expires/nonces and key IDs. We'll publish reference implementation and an audit checklist.

ian_hw: Can we provide a small C reference lib for embedded partners? Even a single-file verifier would cut integration time.

lee_sdk: Good idea. I'll open a repo under partners/reference-libs with C and Rust single-file verifiers.

josh_partnerships: Communications: I'll draft partner email, FAQ, and targeted outreach for top-10 SI/hardware partners. Recommend running two live migration office hours sessions.

sara_pm: Owners (initial):
- Announcement + timeline: sara_pm, josh_partnerships
- SDK migration helpers + ref libs: lee_sdk
- Security API + rotation docs: nina_security
- Hardware impact + firmware outreach: ian_hw
- CI canary + infra: devops (cc eng-infra)

partner-bot: Reminder: create Jira epic "PARTNER-WEBHOOK-V2" and tag partner tickets. Suggested: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PW-100

lee_sdk: I'll prepare code snippets for quick copy into partner repos. Example:
```js
// old callback body
POST /callbacks  { callback_id: "123", data: {...} }

// new envelope
POST /webhook  { event: "callback.received", records: [{ id: "123", payload: {...} }], meta: {version: "v2"} }

// header example
X-RW-HMAC-V2: kid=abc123;ts=1700000000;nonce=6f4a;sig=BASE64
```

josh_partnerships: Please include migration timeline per partner in the Jira epic. I'll prioritize partners with active marketplace connectors first.

nina_security: We'll run a short crypto review and post a checklist. Also: provide mitigations if partners cannot rotate keys immediately (long-lived fallback token with constrained scope).

ian_hw: I'll build the hardware impact spreadsheet and include required firmware version, estimated OTA time, and contacts. ETA: 72h.

sara_pm: OK action items: publish migration guide + CLI tool to transform old callbacks -> new envelope (lee_sdk), open reference libraries (lee_sdk), schedule two partner webinars (josh_partnerships), create canary + nightly CI checks (eng-infra), draft announcement copy (sara_pm + marketing).

josh_partnerships: I'll start outreach immediately. Asking partners to opt into the canary so we can catch issues.

lee_sdk: I'll open PRs for node/python/go sample migrations and the C verifier today.

nina_security: I'll put the rotation guide up and run the crypto review by EOD tomorrow.

ian_hw: Sharing the hardware matrix to this thread when ready.

sara_pm: Thanks all. Keeping this thread as the coordination hub. Will post final announce draft here before sending. If anything blocks owners, flag it here.
